It defines provenance, interpretation, compression, adoption, and reuse boundaries around `BLIND_TOKEN_ORIGIN_COORDINATE`, the sealed `BLIND_TOKEN_ORIGIN_IDENTITY`, and the Creator Theory high-frame.
